Review for FabHotel Dwarika Heritage
Stay: Check-in – 22 November 2025 | Check-out – 23 November 2025
Booking: Two rooms with breakfast | Family trip

My experience at FabHotel Dwarika Heritage was disappointing and far from what was shown on MMT or other online platforms. At the time of check-in, we had to wait for a long time at the reception because the hotel seemed to prioritise couples who are their frequent or routine customers. This was unexpected and unprofessional.

Although I booked rooms with breakfast included, the hotel does not even have a restaurant. When I requested breakfast, they offered only 3–4 items. Even then, they asked, “How many aloo parathas—one?” despite us being a family with a paid breakfast for all members. On top of that, we were not allowed to choose both tea and coffee—only one beverage per person.

Basic amenities like a hair dryer were also missing, which was surprising for a property associated with the FabHotel brand.

The location is another major issue. The hotel is situated in a very narrow lane, and vehicles cannot reach the property. We had to walk nearly 300–400 meters to get there. There are no nearby cafés or restaurants either, so we had to rely entirely on Zomato, Blinkit, or walk outside even for basic things like tea.

Overall, this property is not suitable for families. It appears to cater mainly to couples booking on an hourly basis. I would not recommend this hotel for a family stay.
